geology.summary: The manganese ore horizon lies at the contact of the underlying Sitasaongi Formation (footwall) and the overlying Mansar Formation (hanging wall) of the Sausar Group, and is associated with gondite. Rocks around the mine include Tirodi Gneisses and the Sitasaongi, Lohangi and Mansar formations. Dongri Buzurg is described as the largest known supergene oxide manganese deposit in the Madhya Pradesh–Maharashtra belt.
geology.structure: Regional strike about E–W (locally ENE–WSW), dipping about 45°–70° south. Nearby, the ore horizon forms the southern limb of an overturned isoclinal anticline plunging 30°–40° east.
geology.source: Review of Mining Plan of Dongri Buzurg Mine, MOIL Limited / Indian Bureau of Mines, proposal period 2017-18 to 2021-22

extra_sources.source: Directorate of Geology and Mining, Govt. of Maharashtra — NMET proposal, Kawalewada–Sakkardara Mn block (G3), Tumsar
extra_sources.point: Stratigraphy, footwall/hanging-wall order, fold structure; states no geophysical map is available for the adjoining block and plans 90–100 m boreholes to confirm depth persistence.

geology.geophysics: The Directorate of Geology and Mining lists geophysical maps (aerogeophysical, ground, regional or local) as not available for the adjoining Kawalewada–Sakkardara block.

A.summary: Blocked by the go / no-go check: no verified mine-level annual ore production for Dongri Buzurg was found in MOIL annual reports or IBM yearbooks (2021-22 to 2023-24).

B.summary: Blocked: 7 occurrence locations now have coordinates from official documents (3 of them share one Chikla lease centre), which is still too few and too clustered for a fair leave-one-out test. No geology map layer yet.

C.summary: Blocked for the same reason as Test B.

D.summary: Availability part done: in July–September of all four years (2021–2024) there were 0–2 usable Sentinel-2 days per season against 7–8 Sentinel-1 days. The radar change image shows broad seasonal change rather than a clear mine signal, so radar usefulness for mine monitoring is not shown yet.

E.summary: Bhandara district (5 mines): total output rose 61% from 2022–23 to 2023–24, while ore at ≥46% Mn fell 41% (0.55% → 0.20% of output) and ore below 25% Mn rose from 3.1% to 8.4% of output. District level, two years only; source page still to be added.

F.summary: Blocked: needs the exploration model from Test B.
